title: docs(spec): actionLayout.record describe names the grid row menus it orders
body:
Fixes #36819

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：在 Studio、生成的参考文档和操作指南里，对象“操作排序”里“记录”一项的说明现在写明它也决定列表每行的“⋮”菜单、右键菜单，以及列表页选中一条记录时底部操作栏里的操作顺序（操作栏最前面的至多三个按钮就取这个顺序）；界面行为本身不变。
- 为什么做：上一轮已让这些行级菜单跟随这个排序，但说明仍只提记录页头，作者或 AI 会低估这个设置管到哪里。
- 出错会怎样：只改说明文字，不改可写的内容和校验；说明写错只会误导阅读者，可直接撤回。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

- `packages/spec/src/data/object-action-layout.ts`: the `record` arm's `.describe()` (and the module docblock's `record` bullet) now names, next to the record header, the actions a grid row already offers, which the order leads and adds none to: the row's ⋮ menu, its right-click menu and, on a list page, the selection bar's actions for one selected record. On those surfaces `pinned` names come first, then `more` names, then the rest as before. The selection bar's buttons, at most three, are the first of that order; a row's own inline button does not change. Description prose only; the schema shape, accepted values and refusals are byte-unchanged.
- `content/docs/references/data/object.mdx`: regenerated (`check:generated --fix`, which proved only `check:docs` stale).
- `packages/spec/liveness/object.json`: the `actionLayout` row's `evidence` no longer calls `arrangedHeaderActions` the one reader. It names the grid row readers `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx#ObjectGrid` (`rankRowActionDefs`) and `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/components/RowActionMenu.tsx#planRowActionMenu` (`orderRowMenuActions`; ⋮ menu, right-click menu, selection bar), plus `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/components/SelectionBar.tsx#planExposedEntries` (the bar's first three as buttons). The `record` child's `evidence` and `note` say the same. `verifiedAt` is 2026-11-26 on the two re-verified rows; no `status` changed; the `list` arm and the `pinned`/`more` grandchildren are untouched.
- `content/docs/ui/actions.mdx` (hand-written guide): the `record` arm paragraph says the same as the describe.
- `.changeset/36819-action-layout-record-describe.md`: `@objectstack/spec` patch (names the selection bar, the guide and the ledger too).

What the code does, read on `origin/main` 4fb03ebb, re-read on 02520ab480 for the selection bar (the text states only this):

- Record header: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx:4723` and `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx:2243` read `actionLayout.record` (record page, side preview, phone bar draw the same header).
- Row menus: `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx:1419-1420` reads `objectSchema.actionLayout.record` and ranks the row defs (`rankRowActionDefs`, `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/rowActionArrangement.ts:46`); `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/components/RowActionMenu.tsx:368-375` orders the menu-bound defs (`orderRowMenuActions`, `rowActionArrangement.ts:72`) after the inline primary is chosen at `RowActionMenu.tsx:366`, so the row's inline button is untouched. The same ranked defs feed the ⋮ cell and the context menu (`ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/objectGridActionsColumn.tsx:164`).
- Selection bar: on a list page a row draws no ⋮ cell (`ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx:2464` on origin/main 02520ab4 `drawRowControls: !listPageGrid`); one selected record's actions come from the same ranked defs (`ObjectGrid.tsx:3816` `singleRowMenu` → `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/components/SelectionBar.tsx:158` `useRowActionPlan(menu, 0)`), listed by `singleRecordEntries` (`:57`, declared actions first), with the first `SELECTION_EXPOSED_ACTIONS = 3` (`:43`) drawn as buttons by `planExposedEntries` (`:73`, width permitting). `rowActionArrangement.ts:27-31` names the same three surfaces.
- The `list` arm's describe and the parent `actionLayout` describe name no row surface and stay true: the list arm's only reader is the list page toolbar (`git grep actionLayout` under `ui/`, non-test).

## Tests

No behaviour changed, so no new test and no ablation (description text only). `packages/spec` typecheck and test run on the final head; readings in Verification.

## Acceptance notes

- `content/docs/ui/actions.mdx` (hand-written): its `record` paragraph carried the same two-surface sentence and button sentence as S1, so it changes in round 3 under the seat's claim amendment 7178504889 (see What changes).
- Owed: a contract-review-tier L2 review of the describe text (a contract face), routed by the seat.
